Nationals With last night's 11-3 win over the Nationals in DC, the Braves took a 4-3 lead on the season series. While the Nationals will have a chance to tie the season series in the first leg being played currently, Atlanta has made it clear through their slated pitchers that they are prioritizing the second leg of the double header. Tonight, with the far superior talent on the mound, we should expect Atlanta to either break their tie with the Nationals, or extend the season series lead to two games if they do indeed win this morning. Chris Sale will toe the rubber to start for the Braves. Through eighteen starts this season, Sale has posted a 2.52 ERA & 1.12 WHIP while spanning 107 innings. Through ten starts on the road this season, Sale owns a 2.64 ERA & 1.12 WHIP.
